name: Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card

annual_fee.note: Increase for new accounts from 2023-10-19 and for existing-account renewals from 2024-02-01.

benefits.name: Hilton resort credit
benefits.qualifying: Eligible direct charges at participating Hilton resorts, including qualifying room and incidental charges; advance-purchase and nonrefundable rates do not qualify.
benefits.note: The $400 semiannual structure began 2024-01-01. Older lists show a $250 resort credit per cardmember year.

benefits.name: Flight credit
benefits.qualifying: Eligible flight purchases made directly with airlines or through Amex Travel.
benefits.note: Older lists show a $250 airline incidental credit. Reports that airfare taxes, seat fees or other airline charges sometimes trigger the credit are transaction observations, not a guarantee.

benefits.name: CLEAR+ credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Join CLEAR+ and charge the membership to the card.
benefits.note: Raised to $219 on 2026-07-01; older $189, $199 and $209 figures are superseded.

benefits.name: Waldorf Astoria / Conrad property credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Book the qualifying Aspire benefit rate through the designated channel; minimum 2 nights.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible on-property incidentals; the room rate is excluded.
benefits.note: Up to $100 per qualifying stay; no annual limit is published.

benefits.name: Hilton Diamond status
benefits.qualifying: Hilton benefits including eligible upgrades, lounge access, brand-dependent breakfast or food and drink, and bonus points.
benefits.note: Held while the eligible account stays open. A further Aspire spend threshold to reach Diamond Reserve was not found.

benefits.name: Fifth award night free
benefits.qualifying: Qualifying all-points stays; the fifth night is free on an eligible standard-room points redemption.

benefits.name: National Executive status
benefits.note: Held while the card is eligible.

benefits.name: Global Dining Access / ticket access
benefits.enrollment_how: Link or use the eligible card as required.
benefits.qualifying: Participating Resy reservations and Amex ticket programs.
benefits.note: Access benefit; a fixed amount was not found.

benefits.name: Amex Venue Collection concessions
benefits.enrollment_how: Enroll one eligible Amex card per Card Member.
benefits.qualifying: 10% back on food and drink at participating stadium and arena concessions; tickets, parking and merchandise excluded.
benefits.note: One allowance per Card Member across all enrolled Amex cards.

certificates.name: Annual free night reward
certificates.value_cap: One night in a standard room with reward availability; no fixed points-price cap; excluded properties and room types apply.
certificates.note: Issued in the first year and at each renewal. Usable any night of the week; standard-room taxes and applicable resort fees are included; nontransferable; the stay must be completed within validity.

certificates.name: Spending free night reward
certificates.value_cap: One night in a standard room with reward availability; no fixed points-price cap; excluded properties and room types apply.
certificates.note: Earned at $30,000 of eligible net purchases in a calendar year; thresholds reset January 1. Same use rules as the annual free night.

certificates.name: Second spending free night reward
certificates.value_cap: One night in a standard room with reward availability; no fixed points-price cap; excluded properties and room types apply.
certificates.note: Earned at $60,000 of eligible net purchases in a calendar year (total, not additional); thresholds reset January 1. Same use rules as the annual free night.

thresholds.unlocks: Another free night reward at $60,000 total spend.
